newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-ARA initiated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ARA initiated as buy.

text.p: Smith Barney has initiated coverage of Mexican construction company Consorcio ARA with a buy recommendation, the company told Reuters on Friday.

A Smith Barney equity research report said their 12-month target price per ADR was $45.70, an upside potential of 40 percent, based on EBITDA growth, "since in our view, ARA's FV/EBITDA multiple has topped out," analyst Carmen Slade wrote in an equity reserach report.

"The Mexican homebuilding industry (in which ARA operates) is highly attractive. ARA has two competitive advantages -- a strong cash position and a large land reserve. Thus, a need for financing does not dilute ARA's earnings," Slade wrote.
ARA nominal shares were meanwhile up 25 centavos in early trade on the Mexican Stock Exchange at 26.30 pesos.
